m01:room.title: The Harbor Hydrometry Shed
m01:room.job: Find how fast the water is rising, and when it reaches the quay deck.

m02:room.title: The Basin Forecast Workshop
m02:room.job: Fit a curve to the basin levels, and find when it reaches the market road.

m03:room.title: The Gauge Integrity Loft
m03:room.job: Check whether the north gauge's forecast comes from the water or from the maths.

m04:room.title: The Sluice Calibration House
m04:room.job: Find which Gate C openings the flow formula works at, and the widest safe one.

m05:room.title: The Road Control Garage
m05:room.job: Find when cars and when rescue trucks must leave the raised causeway.

m06:room.title: The Island Dispatch Hall
m06:room.job: Find what kind of growth the north feeder is on, and its load by noon.

m07:room.title: The Weather Relay Block
m07:room.job: Read the pressure model off the log wall, and the sea lift it brings by noon.

m08:room.title: The Signal Conversion Annex
m08:room.job: Turn the old sensor's counts back into a water level.

m09:room.title: The Warning Time Office
m09:room.job: Find when the feeder load reaches the breaker limit, and when shed staging must start.

m10:room.title: The Tide Harmonics Hall
m10:room.job: Build a cosine model of the plain tide, and find when high water comes.

m11:room.title: The Phase Analysis Cabin
m11:room.job: Find when the storm tide stands on the causeway deck, and when it clears.

m12:room.title: The Breakwater Model Room
m12:room.job: Find how high storm waves climb the breakwater face.

m13:room.title: The Pilotage Chart Room
m13:room.job: Check both autopilot headings for one run out to the turbine and home again.

m14:room.title: The Lock Radar Station
m14:room.job: Find whether the service vessel is outside the real jet zone.

m15:room.title: The Grid Isolation House
m15:room.job: Find the window between the vessel clearing the jet zone and the causeway flooding.
